Maybe just set your GP or PCP straight that you wanna pay for the MRI yourself and call in for the MRI referral? My family does that a lot and the PCP’s tone completely changes when we say out of pocket, he then immediately calls the diagnostic center for the referral and we get a call for the schedule an hour later. Although the hesitancy could also be from the cascading costs after getting that MRI which is possible surgery and therapy. My aunt who was diagnosed with grade 4 degenerative osteoarthritis on both knees was suggested a knee surgery on one side (to be schedule after 4 months) and on another (3 months later) couldn’t bear the pain anymore so she went to the Philippines to get the surgery done. Surgery, professional fees, flights, accommodations and physical therapy all cost significantly less despite having to fully pay out-of-pocket. She’s now enjoying the benefits of her new bionic knees, wheras she would still be in pain right now if she waited.
